title: WALL-E V2.1 review R07: user-controlled step ending with outstanding work (design only)
$comment: Design-only current integration contract. F_ definitions describe formation data; L_ definitions derive from v16 source SHA256 72a619bcbbd20f538cd601dbdf27944a062b3f8397d7be3461cb30d296584c91. This file does not publish frozen resources. Named DTO validation and program guards are mandatory. Initialization focus is derived from the first step; switching changes focus only. formation_card_binding_v3 excludes root version/current_step_ref/active_branch_ref from formation_digest; task inputs freeze discussion_step_ref. Result routing, truthful branch closure, immutable proposal basis and component outcomes remain program-owned. Empty submitted disposition lists are allowed; the program fills a complete truthful Closure with OUTSTANDING and KEEP_OPEN, without requiring user waiver or automatic transfer. Missing deliverables are advisory; identity, evidence, versions, idempotency and transaction guards remain mandatory. Selected focus-change events are represented in Canonical and Wire; NodeActivity summaries remain lifecycle/write slots. Historical schemas remain unchanged.
